status: Implementation baseline; no live migrations applied

tables.purpose: Supabase-owned authentication identity. Only the referenced primary key is shown; this is not a complete definition of the managed table.
rules: Read authentication state through supported Supabase APIs; do not manage passwords or refresh records in application tables.
One auth user can have multiple provider identities and device sessions.

tables.purpose: The SpendWise display identity shared across sessions, group memberships, and financial attribution.

columns.name: display_name
columns.description: Proposed trimmed length: 1–100 characters. Later Google sign-ins never overwrite edits.

rules: FastAPI provisions missing profiles idempotently before group use.
No password, email verification, or access/refresh token columns. Email remains authoritative in Supabase Auth.
Proposed FK deletion policy: RESTRICT to preserve attribution. No direct client grants.

tables.purpose: One shared-expense group with one currency, one date-validation timezone, and a permanent currency lock after financial activity.

columns.name: currency_code
columns.description: CHECK in INR, USD, CAD, GBP, EUR.

columns.name: timezone
columns.description: Validate against supported IANA timezone names; immutable after creation.

columns.name: currency_locked_at
columns.description: Set on first financial entry, never cleared after deletion.

columns.name: is_active
columns.description: Set false when final active member leaves.

rules: Currency cannot change once currency_locked_at is non-null. Group timezone is fixed.
Proposed: serialize financial and membership changes by locking the group row. Recheck actor access after acquiring the lock.
Final departure requires all balances zero, inactivates the group and revokes invitations in one transaction.
Group renaming is proposed; permanent group deletion is outside the MVP.
indexes: No extra group-name index required for joined-group lists.

tables.purpose: Persistent identity of a profile in a group. The same membership row is reactivated after a valid invitation is accepted.

columns.name: is_active
columns.description: Current access flag; removal is not row deletion.

columns.name: departed_at
columns.description: Non-null while inactive; departure details remain in membership_events.

rules: UNIQUE (group_id, profile_id) prevents duplicate memberships.
UNIQUE (group_id, id) supports same-group composite foreign keys from financial tables.
CHECK active implies departed_at is NULL; inactive implies it is non-null.
Leaving or removal requires every direct balance involving this member to be zero.
Never physically delete memberships; departure removes group access.
indexes: Partial index (profile_id, group_id) WHERE is_active for joined-group lists.

tables.purpose: Reusable bearer invitation with expiry, creator attribution, hashed secret, and revocation state.

columns.name: token_hash
columns.description: Store only the digest of a cryptographically random high-entropy token.

columns.name: created_by
columns.description: Revoke this creator’s links on departure.

rules: CHECK expires_at > created_at; creation service fixes duration at seven days.
Reject expiry, revocation, inactive group, or unverified acceptance. Revalidate under the group lock.
Multiple links can coexist. Repeated acceptance while active returns existing membership.
Full token is returned once; a replacement link can be created if it is no longer available.
indexes: UNIQUE (group_id, id) for same-group membership-event references.
Partial index (group_id, created_by) WHERE revoked_at IS NULL for revocation.

tables.purpose: Append-only join, leave, and removal history, including rejoining and the invitation accepted.

columns.name: event_type
columns.description: CHECK in joined, left, removed. A later joined event records rejoining.

columns.name: invitation_id
columns.description: Null for creator’s initial join; otherwise the accepted invite on joining.

rules: Append-only; never edit or delete past events.
Membership state and event are written in the same transaction.
When invitation_id is present, validate that it belongs to the same group; proposed composite FK requires UNIQUE (group_id, id) on invitations.
indexes: UNIQUE (group_id, id) on invitations for same-group references.

tables.purpose: One shared expense, one payer, editable transaction date, split method, and versioned soft deletion.

columns.name: payer_membership_id
columns.description: Composite FK (group_id, payer_membership_id); payer need not be a participant.

columns.name: name
columns.description: Proposed trimmed length: 1–200 characters; icons derived from name.

columns.name: amount_minor
columns.description: Positive whole minor units; no floating point. CHECK <= 99999999999.

columns.name: transaction_date
columns.description: Editable; no future date in group timezone.

columns.name: version
columns.description: CHECK > 0; increment for every correction or deletion.

columns.name: deleted_at
columns.description: Soft-deleted entries are excluded from balances and normal lists.

rules: UNIQUE (group_id, id) enables same-group child references.
Validate active payer/participants for new entries. Departed-member edit policy is still under review.
Sum of current shares must equal amount_minor. Percentages must sum to 10000 basis points for percentage splits.
Proposed: deferred database constraint triggers validate cross-row share totals and split inputs at commit.
Entry, shares, history, version increment, and permanent currency lock change atomically.
CHECK date against today is service validation, not a time-dependent table CHECK.
indexes: Partial (group_id, transaction_date DESC, created_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL.

tables.purpose: Final allocated amount for each participant, plus original percentage input where applicable.

columns.name: membership_id
columns.description: Composite FK (group_id, membership_id); one share per participant.

columns.name: amount_minor
columns.description: CHECK >= 0. Exact input is this amount; equal input is implicit. CHECK <= 99999999999.

columns.name: percentage_basis_points
columns.description: 0–10000 for percentage splits, otherwise NULL. 3333 means 33.33%.

rules: PRIMARY KEY (expense_id, membership_id).
Payer’s own share is spending participation but creates no self-debt.
Use integer/rational split calculation; largest fractional remainder wins leftover units, stable membership ID breaks ties.
No independent share deletion or soft-delete flag: shares belong to an expense revision. Old versions live in immutable expense history.
Cross-row and parent split-method consistency checked by proposed deferred constraint triggers.
indexes: Index (group_id, membership_id, expense_id) for balance queries.

tables.purpose: A recorded external payment between two group members. It reduces direct debt and never counts as spending.

columns.name: amount_minor
columns.description: CHECK > 0. New repayment cannot exceed current direct debt. CHECK <= 99999999999.

columns.name: transaction_date
columns.description: Editable and backdatable; no future date in group timezone.

columns.name: payment_method
columns.description: One method per repayment: cash or other. User requested payment_methods; singular column stores the selected value.

columns.name: payment_method_label
columns.description: NULL for cash; required trimmed 1–100 characters for other, e.g. GPay, PhonePe, CRED.

columns.name: created_by
columns.description: Any active member may record it.

rules: CHECK sender_membership_id <> recipient_membership_id.
UNIQUE (group_id, id) for same-group history references.
For creation: both parties active; sender currently owes recipient; amount <= that debt. Check under group lock.
Do not retroactively invalidate a historical repayment when an expense correction reverses balances.
Repayment edit validation and party changes remain explicit open questions.
CHECK payment_method in cash, other. Cash requires NULL label; other requires trimmed nonblank label up to 100 characters.
Payment method and label are included in repayment revisions and canonical retry fingerprints.
indexes: Partial (group_id, transaction_date DESC, created_at DESC, id DESC) WHERE deleted_at IS NULL.

tables.purpose: Immutable full before/after snapshots of expense creation, correction, and soft deletion, including all shares.

columns.name: before_values
columns.description: Full prior entry and ordered shares; required for update/delete.

columns.name: after_values
columns.description: Full resulting entry and ordered shares, including deletion state.

rules: Append-only. Proposed role grants allow INSERT/SELECT but no UPDATE/DELETE, backed by mutation-rejecting triggers.
Creation has NULL before_values; update/delete has a complete object. Snapshots contain integer money and IDs.
Snapshot creation is atomic with expense/share mutation. Never store tokens or credentials.
Snapshots preserve values at revision time; current profile names may still change separately.

tables.purpose: Immutable before/after snapshots of repayment creation, correction, and soft deletion.

columns.name: before_values
columns.description: Full prior repayment; required for update/delete.

columns.name: after_values
columns.description: Full resulting repayment, including deletion state.

rules: Same append-only and atomic write policies as expense_revisions.
Dedicated history tables keep real foreign keys to their parent records.
Changing a transaction date is a normal audited correction, not a new repayment.

tables.purpose: Remembers one successful financial create, replacement or deletion so a retry returns the original result.

columns.name: actor_id
columns.description: The authenticated caller scopes each request key.

columns.name: request_key
columns.description: PRIMARY KEY (actor_id, request_key); reuse on retry.

columns.name: operation
columns.description: CHECK in create_expense, replace_expense, delete_expense, create_repayment, replace_repayment, delete_repayment.

columns.name: request_hash
columns.description: Includes operation, group, target, canonical financial data and expected version where applicable.

columns.name: response_status
columns.description: Recorded only with successful committed creation.

rules: Confirmed: same key + same operation/data returns original result; changed operation/data conflicts. Different key is a new command, never payload deduplication.
Proposed: reserve key, lock group, validate, create entry/history, and record response in one transaction; failed attempts roll back.
Concurrent duplicate submissions wait on uniqueness and replay the committed result.
Proposed retention: retain successful keys for MVP lifetime; do not purge and silently turn late retries into new payments.
Replay still requires current group access and verified authentication. A replay response describes the original operation, not the latest edited entry.
indexes: Index (group_id) for administration; no cleanup TTL proposed.
